version_basis: V0 = the R2-PROMPT P1-arm pairing per model (VERSIONS.md §9, filled by A1.3, dense re-pinned by A2.4). Published because SYS-OPT closed at its ceiling (VERSIONS.md §4) with nothing adopted: best version = V0.
design_requirement: ONE prompt artefact, identical bytes on both models; only the served endpoint differs. Per-model serving configs are the only permitted difference (VERSIONS.md §7).

P1.shape:
SCAFFOLD (with RUN-SALT line) + pointer_index(turn-1) + '
NEWEST DELTA:
' + delta_block(turn) + '
' + CANARY
P1.index_line: t%03d | <len(block)> | <sha256(block)[:8]> | <first 90 flattened chars of block, U+2026 if clipped>
P1.edit_policy: append-only — an entry once written is never rewritten in P1

P3.shape: P1 with one earlier index line rewritten at turn 40

lines: You are an offline cache-probe agent working over a transcript.
TASK: answer the newest delta. Do not restate the history.
OUTPUT CONTRACT: one JSON object per turn with keys {answer, evidence_ids, confidence}. No prose outside the object.
scaffold_order.salt_line_appended_by_the_round_driver: RUN-SALT: <salt>  (sysopt_r1.py:94 — after the four frozen lines, unchanged position)
scaffold_order.anchor_marker: CANARY = "turn-canary-occamy-vllm-cell-0042", placed as the final line of every P1 render (vllm_cell.py:91-100)

pointer_block.quote_tokens_note: V1 raised this to 40 (A2.2) and was FALSIFIED on both models; A2.2's pre-registered falsification reverts it to 0. Lever 1 may not be retried without a new measured finding (VERSIONS.md §8).
pointer_block.entry_cap: none — one entry per delta in the body, up to the turn

tail_policy.pad_to_note: grid padding is withdrawn — it costs (P2/P1 +20.8429, CI [+9.857, +31.486], cells/P2-REPAD, sha256 1e55300788daf62c01376486beee5f1174b2dc8c8c53b60d0b8900a8131a5f44); VERSIONS.md A1.1/A1.5

delta_batching.note: every k>1 was never measured in this lineage

edit_policy.note: P3's mid-edit rewrite is a control, never the released policy

prompt_stream_digest.what: concatenation of the 71 P1 prompts, turns 1..71, released form, salt line 'RUN-SALT: sysopt-r1-20261024T12:30Z-a1'
prompt_stream_digest.provenance: computed by SYS-OPT-CLOSE from the frozen renderer module (vllm_cell.py) + the sysopt_r1.py overrides, offline, 0 requests. NOT read out of a cell row file: the rows carry per-row prefix_sha256 only.
prompt_stream_digest.verification_limit: This digest proves the release is reproducible from the frozen renderer plus the documented overrides. It does NOT prove the V0 baseline rows were rendered with it — V0's rows are R2-PROMPT's and predate the salt line.
prompt_stream_digest.stale_salt_warning: The salt is the round-1 salt. Re-cutting the salt regenerates the digest; the release bytes are otherwise identical.

shared.config_sha256_recipe: sha256 of json.dumps(argv, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')) — tools/best_config_build.py:84-88
shared.verified_by_close_unit: both config_sha256 values below were re-derived from state/config/best-config.json argv by SYS-OPT-CLOSE and match

moe.why: production substrate, untouched by every round of this lineage

dense.why: 9B never started on SGLang (:8017 answered nothing at 11:53Z), so dense serves on vLLM O4; A2.4 re-pinned dense V0 to O4/P1 so the delta is measured on the serving endpoint

cross_engine_reference.status: RETAINED AS A CROSS-ENGINE REFERENCE ONLY (A2.4). Not the dense delta basis; must never be quoted as if dense ran on SGLang.

claims_this_release_may_make: One prompt artefact, byte-identical across MoE and dense: V1 round 1 measured 213/213 (arm,turn) pairs with 0 mismatched prefix_sha256 (state/sys-opt-v1.json prompt_byte_identity).
V0/P1 on MoE (O1 SGLang :8012) = 522.718 unc/turn, hit 0.770, 71 turns.
V0/P1 on dense (O4 vLLM :8014) = 1664.352 unc/turn, hit 0.268, 71 turns.
No prompt version was adopted: SYS-OPT closed at ceiling round 1 with verdict no_signal.

No quality claim: the frozen quality set's P0 form is unanswerable by construction (A2.3) and the absolute P1-form mismatch rates are 100 % (MoE) and 95 % (dense).
No improvement claim for any SYS-OPT version: V1 raised unc/turn by +130.113 (MoE) and +228.817 (dense), CIs excluding zero (state/sys-opt-v1.json).
No engine-swap claim: O1/O4 are the substrates the paired numbers were measured on; nothing here measures O3 or O2.
